name: groundwork
description: Lightweight evidence-first workflow routing for non-trivial Codex R&D tasks. Use for requirement shaping, scoped implementation, verification, compact handoff, and explicit advanced routing or wiki maintenance.

interface.longDescription: Groundwork helps Codex choose a light workflow for non-trivial R&D tasks: shape requirements, scope implementation, verify evidence, preserve compact handoff, or explicitly route dispatch/wiki work. Small obvious tasks should stay direct.
defaultPrompt: Answer small, obvious, low-risk requests directly.
Use Groundwork only when context, risk, reuse, or verification needs a workflow.
Load strict runtime/release/cache/UAT/dispatch/wiki references only when in scope.
